nodes.summary: Let $\mathcal{L} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ be a discrete $\mathbb{Z}$-submodule of rank $m$. Its basis matrix $B(\mathcal{L})$ is the real $n \times m$ matrix whose $j$-th column is the $j$-th vector of a fixed, arbitrarily chosen $\mathbb{Z}$-basis of $\mathcal{L}$.
nodes.title: Basis matrix of a lattice

nodes.summary: For a discrete $\mathbb{Z}$-submodule $\mathcal{L} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ with basis matrix $B = B(\mathcal{L})$ (the real matrix whose columns form a fixed $\mathbb{Z}$-basis of $\mathcal{L}$), the determinant of $\mathcal{L}$ is $\det(\mathcal{L}) = \sqrt{\det(B^{T} B)}$.
nodes.title: Determinant of a lattice

nodes.summary: Let $\mathcal{L} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$ be a full-rank lattice, that is, a discrete subgroup of $\mathbb{R}^n$ that spans $\mathbb{R}^n$, such that every subgroup $\mathcal{L}' \subseteq \mathcal{L}$ (a lattice of possibly lower rank) has determinant $\det(\mathcal{L}') \ge 1$. nodes.title: Reverse Minkowski theorem

nodes.summary: For a real number $s$ and a $\mathbb{Z}$-submodule $\mathcal{L} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^n$, the Gaussian mass of $\mathcal{L}$ at parameter $s$ is $\rho_s(\mathcal{L}) = \sum_{y \in \mathcal{L}} e^{-\pi \|y\|^2 / s^2}$, where $\|y\|$ is the Euclidean norm.
nodes.title: Gaussian mass of a lattice

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
